title: sister_used_my_parkour_world_as_a_dare
beats: My little sister bet her friends $50 she could beat my Minecraft parkour map blindfolded, and now I'm being blamed for her concussion.
I (28F) built this map for MY channel. Twelve levels, no checkpoints, one mistake and you fall into lava.
She (16F) recorded herself playing it blindfolded, tripped over her own chair, and face-planted into her desk.
Her friends stopped filming and called our mom instead of an ambulance, which tells you everything.
Mom (54F) called ME, furious, screaming that I 'built a death trap' in a video game.
I said the trap only works if you play a video game blindfolded in real life for internet points.
My sister is fine, three stitches, but now she's telling everyone I 'pressured' her into the bet.
I never even knew about the bet until the ambulance was already gone.
Dad's siding with her because apparently I should have 'made the map safer' for a sixteen-year-old who wasn't supposed to be playing it at all.
